verdict.rationale: The evidence shows code portability features: GitHub sync, an `eject` command that clones an app into a local project, and an SDK for building your own frontend against Base44 as a backend. None of it documents deploying the generated app to an external host or self-managed infrastructure. Eject creates a new Base44 project with its own app ID, and custom domains are served by Base44's own hosting, so these are adjacent building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the generated app to an external host or my own infrastructure
